Incline Dumbbell Press is my pick for your upper chest. Set the bench to about 30°, because a steeper angle shifts the work to your shoulders. Dumbbells give you a deeper stretch and are easier on the shoulders, and the extra chest size should help your 100 kg bench goal. 💪 I put a card above with an Add to today button.
Sounds good, add it to today's workout.
